messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Elevated error rate + 5xx for model redwood-1.3 served from eu-west1 · triggered at 2129001234. Severity: P2. Paging lee (oncall).

lee (oncall): seeing it in pager — spike started ~2m ago. Confirmed 502/504 on /v1/generate for routes using redwood-1.3-eu.

mike (eng-runtime): on it. Can you share sample request ids? I want to check kernel failures vs infra.

lee (oncall): req ids: r_8f3a, r_8f3b, r_8f40 — pasted logs to #eng-runtime-logs.

ana-sys (log-bot): uploaded logs: https://logs.internal/replay/2129001234/ (no access outside org)

mike (eng-runtime): quick scan: model process OOMs and fast restarts on two hosts in eu-west1 pool. Not seeing degraded GPU health yet. Suspect new quantized kernel in rollout.

ana-sys (deploy-bot): Canary rollout redwood-1.3 -> 10% eu-west1 started at 2128999800, step to 25% scheduled.

ana-sys (deploy-bot): Canary pause triggered by health checks failing.

ana-sys (deploy-bot): Rollback triggered to redwood-1.2 on canary hosts.

mike (eng-runtime): I just kicked an emergency rollback for the variant in eu-west1 canary hosts. Full rollback of 1.3 -> 1.2 for the canary group in progress. Will report back once steady.

tara (product): drafting status page + customer notice. We should be explicit about impacted routes and mitigation (rollback + pin guidance).

lee (oncall): quick question: do we pin traffic away from any pooled hosts, or rely on rollback?
\
ana-sys (deploy-bot): Rollback completed on canary hosts at 2129001500. Traffic auto-failed-over to stable 1.2 variant.
\
mike (eng-runtime): can confirm canaries are healthy after rollback. Error rate dropped in canary group. Global traffic still ramping but look stable so far.
\
ana-sys (monitor-bot): error_rate /v1/generate eu-west1: 4.8% -> 0.7% over last 5m.
\
ana-sys (incident-bot): Auto-check: any remaining degraded pods? 0 failing pods reported.
\
ana (eng-sre): Recommend a short-term route pin for customers on dedicated/dedicated-capacity who observed issues, to prevent hitting a new rolling deploy until we validate fix. For hosted customers, we can keep canary paused and block further 1.3 rollouts.
\
mike (eng-runtime): Agreed. For pinned guidance, use this config snippet:

```
# example: pin customer route to model redwood-1.2
route: prod/chat
model: redwood-1.2
pin_until: 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z
reason: emergency rollback after 1.3 canary failures
```

mike (eng-runtime): Ops note: `pin_until` can be omitted to pin indefinitely; remove when 1.3 validated.
\
tara (product): Status page draft for incidents.redwood.ai:

"We are investigating elevated error rates affecting text generation (model redwood-1.3) in eu-west1. On-call engineers identified failures during a canary rollout and rolled back the canary to the prior model version. Traffic is recovering; we will provide an update within 30 minutes. Impact: some requests to /v1/generate returned 5xx. Mitigation: rollback to redwood-1.2 and pause of further redwood-1.3 rollouts in eu-west1."
\
tara (product): Customer email draft (short):

Hi —

We observed errors for generation requests in eu-west1 caused by a recent model variant rollout. We've rolled back the canary to the previous model (redwood-1.2) and paused further rollouts while we investigate. If you continue to see errors, please reply with a request id and region. We'll keep you updated.

Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success

jasper (cust-success): LGTM. For customers on Dedicated, we should offer an immediate model pin at their request and include a one-time credit for observed errors. I'll prep a template for account teams.

ana (eng-sre): Suggested internal comm to platform teams: brief timeline and next steps.

```
Timeline (internal):
- 2128999800: rollout redwood-1.3 canary -> 10% eu-west1
- 2129001200: SLO alarms triggered (elevated 5xx)
- 2129001234: Pager fired, oncall engaged
- 2129001500: rollback completed on canaries
- 2129001800: monitoring shows steady recovery
Next steps:
- block further 1.3 rollouts in eu-west1
- investigate kernel/quantization change in 1.3 build
- prepare regression test run against internal corp prompt-set
```

ana (eng-sre): Also adding a checklist for oncall handoff:
- confirm rollback completed
- ensure canary pause enforced in deployment pipeline
- confirm SLOs returning to baseline
- coordinate postmortem owner (tbd)

lee (oncall): handing off to ana for next shift. Ana: everything's stable in eu-west1 canaries after rollback, but please watch for recurrence and hold any 1.3 rollouts.

ana (eng-sre): ack — I'll take it. Setting an oncall watch for 2h and will run a quick smoke test against representative prompts.

mike (eng-runtime): recording action items:
- block 1.3 rollout in eu-west1 (done)
- run regression job on 1.3 quant kernels (started)
- collect failing traces and attach to PR for rollback root cause

tara (product): will post the status page update now (copy above) and send the short customer note to accounts. Jasper, can you handle dedicated customers outreach?
\
jasper (cust-success): Yup — will message top impacted accounts with pin instructions and offer credit template. Draft pasted in #customer-templates.
\
mike (eng-runtime): quick note on model-pinning semantics for the comms: pinning at routing layer will ensure traffic sticks to redwood-1.2 even if 1.3 restarts rollout. Good for a temporary safe state.
\
lee (oncall): closing pager for now — monitoring watch remains. If error_rate > 1.5% for next 15m re-escalate to P1.
\
incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated -> monitoring (P2). Next update due 2129002134.
\
ana (eng-sre): leaving the thread with notes and evidence links in the incident tracker: https://incidents.internal/2129001234. Postmortem owner: tbd (assigning after root cause).
\
mike (eng-runtime): thanks all. Will follow up in postmortem with kernel-level findings and repro steps.
\
tara (product): nice work. Keeping canary paused until we have a green regression.
\
lee (oncall): end of thread — handing off to ana on watch.
